name: Glory Slider
author: aumsrini

sections.description:
Glory Slider is a lightweight and responsive WordPress plugin that allows you to create an image slider using the Bootstrap framework. You can upload images, configure slider speed and interval, and display the slider on the front end using a shortcode.

Features:
– Upload multiple images via the WordPress media uploader.
– Configure slider speed and interval.
– Responsive design using Bootstrap.
– Easy-to-use shortcode: [glory_slider].

sections.installation:
1. Upload the glory-slider folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to “Glory Slider” in the WordPress admin menu to configure the slider settings.
  4. Use the [glory_slider] shortcode to display the slider on any page or post.
sections.faq:
How do I add the slider to my website?

Use the [glory_slider] shortcode in any page or post to display the slider.

Can I customize the slider speed and interval?

Yes, you can configure the slider speed (in milliseconds) and interval from the plugin’s settings page.

Is the slider responsive?

Yes, the slider is built using the Bootstrap framework, making it fully responsive.
